metadata.description: TensorsLab image and video API skills, plus Miaodashi Visual Workshop workflows for ecommerce and campaign creative production.

plugins.name: tl-image
plugins.description: TensorsLab Image Generation Skill. Seamlessly generate high-quality images via Text-to-Image or edit/synthesize using Image-to-Image. Features intelligent prompt enrichment and automated local file delivery.

plugins.name: tl-video
plugins.description: TensorsLab Video Generation Skill. Effortlessly create stunning videos via Text-to-Video or animate images via Image-to-Video. Includes automatic scene property deduction, real-time terminal progress tracking, and seamless local downloads.

plugins.name: miaodashi-workshop
plugins.description: Miaodashi Visual Workshop. Create reviewable ecommerce image/video plans, preflight exact TensorsLab client commands without calling the API, approve locally, and record QA with selective retries.
